body.purpose: Running prose, list items, table cells. 13px.

title.purpose: The one H1 on a page. 20px bold.

hint.purpose: Secondary explanation under a control or a command. 12px.

tag.purpose: Status tags: pass, fail, warn. Uppercase, 11px.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Hover and focus transitions on buttons, fields and cards. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

radii.name: ui
radii.purpose: The only radius: buttons, inputs, cards, tags.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a document exists for. Solid ink, no border.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 20px; background: #ebdbb2; color: #1d2021; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 13px/1.55 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #fbf1c7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ebdbb2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Every secondary action. No fill, no border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 20px; background: transparent; color: #ebdbb2; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 13px/1.55 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 200ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ebdbb2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: A field with a bottom rule only. The rule brightens on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { height: 34px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; background: #282828; color: #ebdbb2; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #928374; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; font: 13px/1.55 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; caret-color: #ebdbb2; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #a89984; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #ebdbb2; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 #ebdbb2; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Pass, fail or warn. The word carries the meaning; the colour repeats it.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #504945; border-radius: 6px; color: #a89984; font: 500 11px/1.45 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tag-ok { color: #b8bb26; border-color: #b8bb26; } .ds-tag-bad { color: #ff8a7a; border-color: #ff8a7a; } .ds-tag-warn { color: #83a598; border-color: #83a598; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A raised surface. Flat, 6px radius, 1px border.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; background: #282828; color: #ebdbb2; border: 1px solid #504945; border-radius: 6px; font: 13px/1.55 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-card strong { color: #83a598; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Output Block
components.description: Terminal and CI output. One failing line carries the colour.
components.html:
ok  README.md
fail  LICENSE is missing
components.css: .ds-output { margin: 0; padding: 12px 16px; background: #282828; color: #a89984; border-radius: 6px; font: 13px/1.55 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; white-space: pre; } .ds-output .ds-bad { color: #ff8a7a; }

narrative.overview:
The house standard is a reference card: a single printed sheet, kept in the drawer above the bench, that says exactly how the parts fit together and nothing more. It is not a brand. It does not have a logo, a campaign, or a personality that it wants to perform. What it has is the authority of a correct document — every line is there because something failed without it.

The visual language follows from that. The reference card is printed on warm paper, in ink, in one typewriter face. It is quiet. Nothing glows, nothing gradients, nothing is centred for the sake of it. The only thing that stands out is the thing that is wrong: a failed check in red, a rule that was broken in a warning amber, a passing check in olive. A reader scanning a page of output should be able to find the failure without reading the failures.
keyCharacteristics: warm paper and ink; no pure white, no pure black
one monospaced face for everything, including prose
status is carried by text and colour together, never by colour alone
flat surfaces: depth comes from tone, not from shadow
one radius, one spacing scale, no exceptions

rules.name: The Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: Every background is built warm. #ffffff and #000000 do not appear as surfaces. A pure black background next to a warm palette looks like a hole in the page.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Body text is never below 4.5:1 against its background. Borders, underlines and focus rings are never below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).

rules.name: The Status Is Doubled Rule
rules.body: A status is always carried by a word as well as a colour — pass, fail, warn. Colour is the fast channel, text is the reliable one.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: A document mixes no other face. A second font means a second opinion about the content, and a reference card has one.

rules.name: The Uppercase Is A Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase marks a label, never a sentence and never a heading. A heading in all caps reads as a banner, and the standard does not shout.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only as a response to state, and in this system that state is the hover on a raised overlay.

dos: Do read every colour through the token names, never as a literal hex inside a rule or a component.
Do show status as a word and a colour together.
Do keep one radius (6px) and one spacing scale.
Do check the dark ground first and the light one second, when a document has to work in both.
Do let the ink do the work. The palette is quiet on purpose.
donts: Don't add a second font, even for code. One face, including code.
Don't use shadow to create depth. Use tone.
Don't colour a thing to make it prettier. Functional colours are functional, and only three of them exist.
Don't put uppercase in a heading or a sentence.
Don't make colour the only carrier of a status.
